title: Revoked certificates
description: An installation's revoked host certificates and their keys. A listed certificate, and every certificate of the same runtime with the same key id, stops every frame and record that relies on it and was not already admitted, whenever that frame or record says it was issued. The authority signs the record again at least every 6 hours, and it lasts at most a day (registry max_lifetime_seconds); a receiver without a current record refuses other hosts' frames (README, "Who sent it").

key_id.description: The revoked certificate's application key: every certificate of this runtime with this key id is revoked too.

expires_at.description: When this version of the record stops being current; at most a day after it is written.
